chapo: Lexie Shoaibi may never know peace again

The word is out – Rockstar has finally revealed the GTA 6 voice cast, and that means various actors are now free to say they've taken part in the game. Naturally, that involves Leonida's favorite princess, Mandy. As you'll see from the link, GTA 6's Mandy is played by Lexie Shoaibi. Not to hide from her newfound stardom, Shoaibi has taken to her Instagram account to announce the news herself – perhaps bravely, depending on how aware she is of the internet's obsession. "OK, now that Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally out, I can share with you guys a secret, which is that I'm in it!" she says. "I play Mandy, I do her voice-over, and I do her motion capture, and she's a lot of fun. So if you play the game, let me know if you find me." Oh, players have found her – and are letting her know. I won't get into the quoting business here, but you can see for yourself if you like. According to IMDb, Shoaibi has done bits and bobs on flicks like Dashboard Light, Atom, and The Good Fight. Her latest role, though, is certainly proving the most viral for the moment. If you've yet to meet Mandy in GTA 6, you likely haven't been playing for long. Fairly early into the game, Jason is sent on errands by Brian Heder, some of which include getting rent from the likes of, you guessed it, Mandy. The two have clearly met before and perhaps shouldn't meet again, given some of the red flags we see after Jason fixes Mandy's sink. If you can look past the woman in the tiny bikini several sizes too small, you'll notice the various murder props – if the severed finger didn't give it away. And if you did manage to look past Mandy, you're part of a small club. The internet has become a steamy enough place that even former Nintendo boss Reggie Fils-Aimé is asking what's going on. "Ok now that Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally out I can share with you guys a secret, which is that I'm in it. I play Mandy, I do her voice over and I do her motion capture, and she's a lot of fun. So if you play the game, let me know if you find me." via Instagram. You'd think that everyone's favourite character in GTA 6 would be either Jason or Lucia—one of the main characters—but no, another front-runner has emerged for fans: Mandy. She's so much of a favourite, in fact, that we've had to confirm that you can't cheat on Lucia with her. You meet Mandy early on in GTA 6 when Jason visits her home to collect the rent she owes to her landlord Brian Heder and also fix her blocked sink. It's pretty apparent that she has a thing for Jason, she is his ex after all, but the feeling isn't reciprocated, no matter how much players want it to be. Things also get a little weird with her as she pushes just a little too far and suggests she's been stalking him, not a great look Mandy. But the weirdest thing of all is what Jason finds in her sink. As he's clearing out the blocked pipe he finds what looks like a severed finger. He only has it for a second before Mandy snatches it out of his hands and runs off with it, but players are pretty sure they saw what they saw. This has led some to believe that Mandy could be a serial killer. Obviously that's only one finger, and to be serial she'd need to have a whole hand at least (come on, do we not have standards anymore?), but her odd behaviour plus the severed finger means that something is more than just a bit off with her. This still isn't enough to dissuade interest in her for some, as one player proudly announces: "I can fix her". Godspeed soldier, better you than me.
